```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, echo=TRUE)
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(modelsummary)
require(lubridate)
require(survey)
```

```{r}
bop_panel <- readRDS("~/R Projects/Moldova General/BOP/bop_panel.rds")
```

Variables of interest:
- Economic_Situation_minus1
- Economic_Situation_plus1
- Economic_Satisfaction
- EconomicSolution_First
- EconomicSolution_Second 
- EconomicSolution_Third

```{r}
bop_panel$year <- year(bop_panel$date)
bop_panel$year.f <- as.factor(bop_panel$year)
bop_panel$wave <- as.factor(bop_panel$wave)
bop_panel$date <- as.Date(bop_panel$date)

# converting to numeric
bop_panel$Economic_Situation_minus1 <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Economic_Situation_minus1)
bop_panel$Economic_Situation_plus1 <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Economic_Situation_plus1)
bop_panel$Economic_Satisfaction <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Economic_Satisfaction)
```

```{r}
# Identifiers and demographics
vars_demographics <- c(
  "id", "wave", "date", "Age", "Age.f", "Gender", "Ethnicity",
  "Language_Questionnaire", "Ecology", "Education", "Socioeconomic",
  "Macro_Region", "Weights")

# Economics
vars_economics <- c(
  "Economic_Situation_minus1", "Economic_Situation_plus1", "Economic_Satisfaction",
  "EconomicSolution_First", "EconomicSolution_Second", "EconomicSolution_Third")

```

```{r}
# removing NA values
bop_panel.econ <- bop_panel %>%
  drop_na(all_of(vars_demographics))

bop_panel.econ <- bop_panel.econ %>%
  drop_na(all_of(vars_economics))
```

# Longitudinal Analysis
```{r}
bop_panel.econ %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    Economic_Situation_minus1_mean = mean(Economic_Situation_minus1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Situation_minus1_sd = sd(Economic_Situation_minus1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Situation_minus1_n = sum(!is.na(Economic_Situation_minus1)),
    Economic_Situation_minus1_se = Economic_Situation_minus1_sd / sqrt(Economic_Situation_minus1_n),
    Economic_Situation_minus1_lower = Economic_Situation_minus1_mean - 1.96 * Economic_Situation_minus1_se,
    Economic_Situation_minus1_upper = Economic_Situation_minus1_mean + 1.96 * Economic_Situation_minus1_se,
    Economic_Situation_plus1_mean = mean(Economic_Situation_plus1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Situation_plus1_sd = sd(Economic_Situation_plus1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Situation_plus1_n = sum(!is.na(Economic_Situation_plus1)),
    Economic_Situation_plus1_se = Economic_Situation_plus1_sd / sqrt(Economic_Situation_plus1_n),
    Economic_Situation_plus1_lower = Economic_Situation_plus1_mean - 1.96 * Economic_Situation_plus1_se,
    Economic_Situation_plus1_upper = Economic_Situation_plus1_mean + 1.96 * Economic_Situation_plus1_se
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Economic_Situation_minus1_mean, Economic_Situation_minus1_lower,
             Economic_Situation_minus1_upper, Economic_Situation_plus1_mean,
             Economic_Situation_plus1_lower, Economic_Situation_plus1_upper),
    names_to = c("Economic_Situation", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Economic_Situation_minus1|Economic_Situation_plus1)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean, color = Economic_Situation , 
                              group = Economic_Situation)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Economic_Situation), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean Score")

```

```{r}
bop_panel.econ %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    Economic_Satisfaction_mean = mean(Economic_Satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Satisfaction_sd = sd(Economic_Satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Economic_Satisfaction_n = sum(!is.na(Economic_Satisfaction)),
    Economic_Satisfaction_se = Economic_Satisfaction_sd / sqrt(Economic_Satisfaction_n),
    Economic_Satisfaction_lower = Economic_Satisfaction_mean - 1.96 * Economic_Satisfaction_se,
    Economic_Satisfaction_upper = Economic_Satisfaction_mean + 1.96 * Economic_Satisfaction_se
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Economic_Satisfaction_mean, Economic_Satisfaction_lower,
             Economic_Satisfaction_upper),
    names_to = c("Economic_Satisfaction", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Economic_Satisfaction)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean Score")
```

# Regression analysis
```{r}
# changing reference categories
bop_panel.econ$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.econ$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel.econ$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.econ$Education, "medium")

# making svy version of dataframe
bop_svy.econ <- svydesign(id=~1, weights=~Weights, data=bop_panel.econ)
```

```{r}
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Age, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Age.f, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Gender, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Ethnicity, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Language_Questionnaire, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Ecology, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Education, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Socioeconomic, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~Macro_Region, design = bop_svy.econ))
summary(svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction~factor(year), design = bop_svy.econ))
```


```{r}
model <- svyglm(Economic_Satisfaction ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + year, design = bop_svy.econ)

summary(model)
```

```{r}
summary(glm(Economic_Satisfaction ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + year, data = bop_panel.econ))
```

```{r}
modelplot(model, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Coefficients and 95% CIs")
```
